method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Start the 70g dry brown rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.

Drain and rinse canned, ready-cooked kidney beans, then weigh out 100g; raw or dried kidney beans cannot be used in this method. Use 180g ready-cooked green lentils; drain before weighing. Do not start this method with dry lentils.

Put the 120g chopped tomatoes and 5g smoked paprika into the non-stick frying pan. Stir over a medium-low heat, then cover and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir twice; keep the heat low enough that the tomato liquid does not boil dry.
Add the drained kidney beans, cover and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring halfway, until the beans are hot through.
Fold in the cooked green lentils and heat gently for 3–5 minutes, stirring, until steaming hot throughout. Spoon over the freshly cooked rice and serve immediately.
